title: Terracotta Hardlight — one wall, one sun, cloth in motion

included: frame-01 — provenance-bound 1024×1280 cover crop; observed back-three-quarter head-return moment with hard graphic light and cloth interference
seven git-preserved reference sheets — approved generative grammar for camera, blocking, expression, garment behaviour, colour, environment and person-template boundaries
source_reconciliation.coverage_policy: frame-01 defines the observed universe; all six runtime shot directions are explicitly labelled original generative extrapolations constrained by the seven preserved sheets, never additional source claims.

palette.name: terracotta wall
palette.role: ground, the whole field behind the subject

palette.name: shadowed brown
palette.role: deepest shadow, the cast diagonal, warm not neutral

palette.name: off-white highlight
palette.role: brightest sunlit completion or highlight; never source-garment authority

palette.role: terracotta-reflected warm midtone; never a required skin value

source_frames: frame-01 — single supplied frame, portrait, back three-quarter turn, white linen open in motion against a terracotta wall
unknowns: focal length in millimetres — never stated, only its consequences
whether the wall is interior or exterior; no floor, ceiling or edge is in frame
what casts the diagonal shadow — the caster is off-frame and only its straight edge is readable
the subject's weight distribution and footwear — the frame cuts above them

runtime_style.visual_system: A graphic warm fashion universe built from one flat terracotta-colour plane, one hard diagonal light/shadow cut, clear air, a back-three-quarter subject with head returned to lens, and approved cloth held in a decisive moving plane.
runtime_style.mood_line: Heat, still attention and one captured cloth movement are cut into a flat field by hard directional light.
runtime_style.environment: Invent a new non-recognisable matte terracotta-colour set plane with subtle mineral texture and one straight diagonal light/shadow field; show no landmark, copied wall, door, vase, signage, floor plan or unsupported room detail.
runtime_style.lighting: One hard directional production source from high camera-left rakes the plane and approved subject, producing a sharp diagonal graphic and warm reflected fill; the physical real-world caster remains UNKNOWN and clear air contains no haze.
materials: original matte mineral or painted set plane in terracotta and deep warm shadow values
subtle surface grain revealed only by the hard rake
clear air with no atmospheric layer or unrelated prop
the approved item in its verified material, construction and colours; never the source white cloth or rust garment design
runtime_style.contrast: High warm contrast with deep brown shadows retaining texture, off-white highlights rolled rather than clipped, and the full environment held inside a near-monochromatic terracotta/rust family.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Head returns toward the lens against a body turned away; gaze is direct or near-direct, lids slightly low, brows and cheekbones at rest, jaw relaxed, mouth closed or softly parted, corners level, and no smile.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Apply one moving plane to the approved item without claiming its cause: free layers may open beyond the shoulder with a crisp edge; heavy items lift as one broad curved fold. Never copy source design.
optical_signature: Every frame is optically clean with moderate non-wide perspective, parallel set-plane edges and no added flare or vignette.
Every frame keeps fine low grain, smooth off-white highlight roll-off and only slight halation on the brightest sunlit approved-cloth edge.
No global bloom, diffusion, haze, chromatic fringe or swirl; hard light geometry and textile microcontrast stay legible.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical chest-to-shoulder-height portrait with moderate perspective; body occupies roughly sixty to eighty percent of frame height while the clean diagonal shadow passes through negative space above and beside the head.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Torso turns back-three-quarter away, near shoulder blade leads, neck rotates the head back to lens, chin level, near elbow relaxed below crop and far arm quiet so no cloth covers the face.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Approved face, returned eye line and near shoulder are sharp; the terracotta plane is gently softer but the diagonal edge remains legible.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: No lens-crossing object; reserve this frame for clean identity and keep moving approved cloth behind the near shoulder.
provenance: frame-01 body-away/head-return and hard-graphic observations + preserved camera_lens and expression_gaze sheets — GENERATIVE EXTRAPOLATION

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Level horizontal or wide vertical from chest height; the approved subject stays forty to fifty-five percent of frame height while the full straight diagonal light/shadow field dominates the flat set plane.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Body stands side-to-three-quarter, pelvis stable, spine upright, one arm lowered and the other elbow slightly opened behind the torso to expose a clear silhouette against both light values.
environmental_hero.focus: Subject and diagonal boundary are both readable; subtle set texture falls slightly softer away from the subject.
environmental_hero.foreground: Nothing crosses the lens; use empty terracotta field as deliberate negative space rather than adding props.
provenance: frame-01 flat orange/dark field + preserved environment and camera_lens sheets — GENERATIVE EXTRAPOLATION

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Slightly low oblique view from the subject's far side, cropped around knee-to-full three-quarter; hard light catches one large approved-cloth plane against the dark half of the wall.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis turns away, spine rotates back, both upper arms lift from the ribs, elbows bend back and outward, and forearms separate so the approved item opens asymmetrically behind the shoulders.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Returned face, leading shoulder and tautest sunlit cloth plane are sharp; trailing edge and wall texture fall a step softer.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: The opened approved layer remains in the subject plane and never becomes a detached prop or flat lay.
provenance: frame-01 turn and displaced cloth + preserved blocking and garment_behaviour sheets — GENERATIVE EXTRAPOLATION

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Close oblique head-and-upper-torso frame from chest height; the lens looks through an opening formed by one near approved-cloth edge while the diagonal wall graphic cuts the opposite side.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Torso continues turning away, head rotates fully back, near elbow opens laterally, near wrist drives the approved free edge toward the lens, and far shoulder anchors the opposite side.
interference_frame.focus: Eyes and cheek on the returned head are sharp; the near cloth is deliberately soft and the wall diagonal remains secondary but legible.
interference_frame.foreground: A defocused approved free edge crosses roughly one quarter of the right or lower frame without hiding both eyes or identity evidence.
provenance: frame-01 observed cloth interference + preserved camera_lens, blocking and garment_behaviour sheets — GENERATIVE EXTRAPOLATION

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Close side-on human-context detail at waist-to-chest height, isolating a gripping hand, approved material edge and adjacent torso against the lit terracotta plane.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: One shoulder-elbow-wrist chain draws the approved layer outward while the opposite hand stabilises it at the waist or rib line; wrist, fingers and torso connection remain visible.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Approved weave, construction detail, fingers and hard sunlit edge are sharp; face may be absent and the wall softens behind.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The approved item fills the near half of frame but must remain attached to a visible hand, wrist and torso; never deliver a product-only cutout.
provenance: frame-01 bright cloth edge + preserved garment_behaviour and camera_lens sheets — GENERATIVE EXTRAPOLATION

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Horizontal oblique view along the original flat set plane from a level camera; the approved subject remains thirty to forty percent of frame height where the diagonal shadow changes value.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Full or near-full standing chain with feet plausibly grounded, torso turned away, head returned toward lens, one elbow extended behind and one lowered so a single cloth plane trails clear of the body.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Subject and the nearest diagonal boundary remain legible; surface texture falls evenly softer along the wall with no added depth set.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: A narrow empty dark-warm band may anchor the lower edge without covering the body; no furniture, foliage or unrelated object enters.
provenance: frame-01 warm field/cloth-motion universe + preserved environment, blocking and camera_lens sheets — GENERATIVE EXTRAPOLATION

camera_lens.prompt: Dense editorial CAMERA & LENS reference board, 16:9, dark neutral look-dev layout, neat labelled panels, film-production house style, hand-set English labels, no photograph of a person anywhere, no version number, no date, no invented metadata of any kind. Headline: 'TERRACOTTA HARDLIGHT — CAMERA & LENS'. PANEL 1 CAMERA POSITION: a clean side-elevation diagram of a featureless wooden artist mannequin standing, camera drawn at CHEST TO SHOULDER HEIGHT with a very slight upward tilt, sight line marked, labelled 'CHEST-SHOULDER · SLIGHT UP'. Beside it a frame diagram with the horizon dead level, labelled 'ROLL LEVEL — NO TILT'. PANEL 2 PERSPECTIVE CHARACTER: two small diagrams contrasting parallel verticals against converging verticals, the parallel one ticked, labelled 'VERTICALS PARALLEL · NORMAL TO SLIGHTLY LONG · BACKGROUND IS A FLAT PLANE SO NO COMPRESSION CUE — UNKNOWN BEYOND NOT WIDE'. PANEL 3 DEPTH OF FIELD: a depth ramp showing the subject sharp and the wall softly rendered while its shadow edge stays legible, labelled 'SUBJECT SHARP · WALL SOFT BUT SHADOW EDGE LEGIBLE'. PANEL 4 FOREGROUND OCCLUSION: an empty frame rectangle with a diagonal line through it, labelled 'NONE — EVERYTHING HAPPENS IN THE SUBJECT PLANE'. PANEL 5 OPTICAL SIGNATURE, marked MANDATORY ON EVERY FRAME AND FIXED FOR THE WHOLE UNIT: sample tiles reading 'NO FLARE', 'SMOOTH HIGHLIGHT ROLL-OFF ON WHITE CLOTH', 'SLIGHT HALATION AT THE BRIGHTEST FOLDS ONLY', 'FINE LOW GRAIN', 'NO VIGNETTE', each tile labelled with a strength word, and a line beneath reading 'THIS UNIT IS OPTICALLY CLEAN — A GLOWING FRAME IS AS WRONG AS A FLAT ONE'. PANEL 6 FRAME: a portrait rectangle roughly 3 to 4 with the subject silhouette in the lower centre and the upper-left third left empty for the shadow graphic, labelled 'PORTRAIT · SUBJECT LOWER CENTRE · UPPER-LEFT GIVEN TO THE SHADOW'. Bottom edge: a palette row of five labelled swatches with hex printed under each: #B5543A, #5A2A20, #F2EDE4, #C89275, #B8552F. Clean technical board, high legibility, no people, no product, no brand mark.

blocking.prompt: Rough pencil BLOCKING sketch on toned paper, 16:9, loose graphite gesture-rough with visible construction lines, NOT finished art, hand-lettered English labels, black and white pencil with one small colour swatch row, no version number, no date, no invented metadata. Headline lettered 'TERRACOTTA HARDLIGHT — BLOCKING'. MAIN FRAME: a featureless wooden artist mannequin, no face, no hair, no gender, no clothing detail, standing with the BACK THREE-QUARTERS to the lens — the torso turned away so one shoulder blade leads — while the HEAD PANS BACK OVER THAT SHOULDER toward the camera. Draw the limb chain explicitly: both upper arms lifted away from the ribs, elbows bent and pointing back and outward, forearms angled up so the garment would open behind them like a wing. Draw the camera at chest to shoulder height with an arrow for its sight line meeting the mannequin's face, and a second arrow for the EYE LINE travelling back over the shoulder straight to the lens. Letter 'HEAD PANS TO LENS · BODY FACES AWAY — THE DIFFERENCE IS THE ATTITUDE'. Draw the hard single light source high and camera-LEFT as a sun symbol with rays, and draw its CAST SHADOW as a straight diagonal band running from upper-left down to mid-right across the wall behind, lettered 'HARD SUN HIGH CAMERA-LEFT · SHARP DIAGONAL CAST SHADOW IS THE MAIN GRAPHIC'. Letter 'ROLL LEVEL' and 'CUT ABOVE THE FEET — WEIGHT UNKNOWN'. BOXED TOP-DOWN PLAN INSET in the bottom-right corner: bird's-eye showing the mannequin footprint with its facing arrow pointing away from camera, the head-turn arc drawn back toward the lens, the camera marker with its angle wedge, the wall as a straight line behind, and the light direction arrow, lettered 'TOP-DOWN PLAN'. Small palette row bottom-left with hex lettered: #B5543A, #5A2A20, #F2EDE4. Schematic diagram only, no rendering, no faces, no text other than the labels.

expression_gaze.prompt: Dense editorial EXPRESSION & GAZE reference sheet, 3:2, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, film-production house style, no version number, no date, no invented metadata. Headline 'TERRACOTTA HARDLIGHT — EXPRESSION & GAZE'. Show a clean grid of six LARGE head-and-shoulders studies of the SAME neutral unnamed generic face, identical identity in every panel, each annotated with anatomical labels rather than mood words. Every panel shows the head turned back over the shoulder toward the lens. Panel labels, lettered exactly: 'GAZE INTO LENS ACROSS THE SHOULDER — A HOLD, NOT A POSE'; 'UPPER LIDS SLIGHTLY LOWERED — TOP SLIVER OF IRIS COVERED, FULL IRIS VISIBLE, NO SCLERA ABOVE'; 'LOWER LIDS UNTENSED'; 'BROWS AT REST AND LEVEL — NO INNER PULL; SLIGHT ASYMMETRY FROM THE TURN, NOT FROM EXPRESSION'; 'CHEEKBONES AT REST — NO LIFT, NO CREASE UNDER THE LOWER LID, NOT A SMILE'; 'LIPS CLOSED, FULL AND SOFT, CORNERS LEVEL — NO COMPRESSION, NO PURSING'. Add a side panel headed 'JAW AND NECK': 'JAW RELAXED · CHIN LEVEL TO A TOUCH RAISED · THE TURN ENGAGES THE NEAR STERNOCLEIDOMASTOID, WHICH READS AS A LINE DOWN THE NECK AND IS PART OF THE FRAME GEOMETRY'. Add a small diagram panel headed 'HEAD ORIENTATION': three icons for pan, tilt and roll with values 'PAN STRONG TO LENS AGAINST A BODY FACING AWAY · TILT NEUTRAL · ROLL NEUTRAL'. Add a signature strip lettered 'SIGNATURE: THE MOTION IS IN THE HAIR AND CLOTH — THE FACE IS STILL. COOL, APPRAISING, UNHURRIED'. Bottom palette row with hex printed: #C89275, #B5543A, #F2EDE4. Hard single-source lighting on the studies from camera-left so the terminator across the cheek reads clearly, fine skin detail, editorial layout, high label legibility.

garment_behaviour.prompt: Dense editorial GARMENT BEHAVIOUR reference sheet, 3:2, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, no version number, no date, no invented metadata. Headline 'TERRACOTTA HARDLIGHT — GARMENT BEHAVIOUR'. This sheet studies WHAT CLOTH DOES, never what cloth is: plain unbranded UNPRINTED fabric studies only, no pattern, no logo, no garment silhouette, no product. PANEL 1 MOTION STATE: a fabric study caught at the PEAK of a driven movement, fully open, labelled 'DRIVEN AT ITS PEAK · THROWN BY THE SUBJECT TURN · CAUGHT FULLY OPEN'. PANEL 2 AIR INTERACTION: cloth leaving the body dramatically, opening as one curved plane well past the shoulder line with a streaming trailing edge, labelled 'OPENS AS A WING PAST THE SHOULDER · TRAILING EDGE STREAMS · AWAY FROM THE TURN, ACROSS THE LIGHT'. PANEL 3 DRAPE AND WEIGHT: a fold study with broad and few folds holding a curved plane rather than collapsing, labelled 'LIGHT TO MID · STRUCTURED ENOUGH TO HOLD A CURVED PLANE · BROAD FEW FOLDS'. PANEL 4 TRANSPARENCY UNDER THIS LIGHT: the same cloth shown twice under a hard side-on sun, mostly opaque with a bright translucent rim only where a single layer catches the sun directly, labelled 'HARD SIDE SUN · MOSTLY OPAQUE · BRIGHT EDGE TRANSLUCENCY ONLY ON A SINGLE LAYER'. PANEL 5 EDGE QUALITY: a crisp hem with a faint motion softening at the fastest-moving edge, labelled 'CRISP · FAINT MOTION SOFTENING AT THE FASTEST EDGE'. PANEL 6 SURFACE RESPONSE: labelled 'MATTE WITH A SLIGHT SHEEN ON THE TAUTEST PLANES'. TRANSFER STRIP along the bottom, lettered: 'A HEAVY GARMENT LIFTS AND HOLDS ONE LARGE CURVED PLANE AWAY FROM THE BODY RATHER THAN FLUTTERING, AND THE HARD SUN DRAWS A BRIGHT HARD-EDGED LINE ALONG ITS UPPERMOST FOLD'. Palette row with hex printed: #F2EDE4, #B5543A, #5A2A20. Hard single-source setup so the edge translucency panel reads truthfully, high label legibility, no people.

colour_grade.prompt: Dense editorial COLOUR & GRADE reference board, 16:9, dark look-dev layout, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, no version number, no date, no board code, no invented metadata. Headline 'TERRACOTTA HARDLIGHT — COLOUR & GRADE'. PANEL PALETTE, marked 'CLOSED SET · PALETTE_SIZE 5': five large swatches in a row, each with its name above and its hex printed beneath in clear type — 'TERRACOTTA WALL #B5543A', 'SHADOWED BROWN #5A2A20', 'OFF-WHITE LINEN #F2EDE4', 'WARM SKIN #C89275', 'RUST #B8552F'. Letter beneath the row: 'FOUR TO FIVE VALUES ONLY — THIS IS WHY THE FRAME READS AS ITSELF'. PANEL EXEMPTIONS, three lines: 'APPROVED ITEM COLOURS', 'SKIN HAIR EYES', 'THE RAMP BETWEEN TWO MEMBERS'. PANEL FORBIDDEN: 'ANY SIXTH COLOUR IS A FAIL, NOT A VARIATION — A GREEN PLANT OR A BLUE SKY BREAKS THIS UNIT'. PANEL CURVE: a tone-curve graph with deep warm shadows retaining detail and highlights not clipped, annotated 'DEEP WARM SHADOWS, DETAIL RETAINED · HIGHLIGHTS NOT CLIPPED · HIGH CONTRAST'. PANEL SPLIT-TONE: annotated 'MONOCHROMATIC-WARM, NEAR-ANALOGOUS · THE WALL BOUNCE WARMS THE SHADOW SIDE TOO, SO THE WHOLE FRAME SITS IN ONE WARM FAMILY RATHER THAN A WARM-COOL SPLIT'. PANEL GRADED SAMPLE: one clean graded plate of a terracotta wall raked by hard sun with a sharp diagonal cast shadow and NO person in it, carrying the palette exactly. Clean technical board, very high type legibility, no people, no product, no photograph of a face.

environment.prompt: Dense editorial ENVIRONMENT PLATES board, 21:9, labelled panels, architectural reference style, hand-set English labels, THE SAME PLACE throughout with identical materials and light across panels, NO PEOPLE in any panel, no version number, no date, no invented metadata. Headline 'TERRACOTTA HARDLIGHT — ENVIRONMENT'. PLATE 1 PLAN: a top-down site diagram showing one flat wall, the subject footprint in front of it, the camera position at chest height, the hard light direction arrow entering from camera-left and high, and the off-frame caster whose straight edge throws the diagonal, with a scale bar and a north arrow. PLATE 2 HERO WIDE: the terracotta wall raked by hard sun with a sharp straight diagonal cast shadow running from upper-left down to mid-right, nothing else in frame. PLATE 3 REVERSE ANGLE: the SAME wall from at least 120 degrees around, a genuinely different viewpoint and not a repeat of the hero — the shadow now reads at a different angle across the surface and the raking light skims the wall texture rather than facing it. PLATE 4 MATERIALS: five labelled swatches — rendered terracotta plaster in #B5543A, the same plaster in deep shadow #5A2A20, off-white linen #F2EDE4, rust textile #B8552F, warm skin reference #C89275. PLATE 5 SIGNATURE DETAILS: the crisp shadow edge itself at close range, the plaster grain in raking light, the transition where the shadow crosses a surface imperfection. PLATE 6 ATMOSPHERE: labelled tiles for LIGHT 'one hard undiffused source, high, camera-left', HAZE 'none, air is clear', TEMPERATURE 'hot', SOUND and SMELL as short notes. Annotate the depth planes as two labelled bands only: 'WALL · SUBJECT', and letter 'THE FRAME HAS NO THIRD PLANE — THAT FLATNESS IS THE UNIT'. Letter one line: 'UNKNOWN — INTERIOR OR EXTERIOR, AND WHAT CASTS THE DIAGONAL'. High detail, high label legibility, no people, no readable brand text.

person.prompt: Dense editorial PERSON SHEET, 2:3, neutral dark studio board, neat labelled panels, hand-set English labels, film-production house style, no version number, no date, no invented metadata. Headline 'TERRACOTTA HARDLIGHT — PERSON SHEET (TEMPLATE)'. This sheet is a TEMPLATE describing what must be recorded about whoever is photographed, not a portrait of any specific individual: use one neutral unnamed generic face, identical in every panel, and label the anatomy rather than naming a person. PANEL FACE GEOMETRY: annotated diagram calling out skull and jaw shape, cheekbone height and projection, brow ridge, nose bridge and tip and nostril shape, philtrum, lip volume and corner direction, chin, hairline shape, neck-to-jaw transition. PANEL EARS: a labelled ear study calling out set height relative to eye and nose line, protrusion, helix curl, lobe attached or free, piercings, lettered 'EARS ARE THE FASTEST TELL OF DRIFT'. PANEL EVERYTHING ON THE FACE: brows density and direction, lashes, eye colour and limbal ring, sclera tone, under-eye structure, glasses frame if worn. PANEL SKIN MARKS, two clearly separated columns lettered 'OBSERVED — READ OFF A FRAME' and 'PLAUSIBLE — CONSISTENT BUT NOT VISIBLE', with a line beneath: 'DISCRETE MARKS MUST BE OBSERVED · CONTINUOUS GEOMETRY MAY BE INFERRED'. PANEL SKIN TONE: a value ramp with hex printed including #C89275, plus undertone and the lit-to-shadow shift, lettered 'THE WALL BOUNCES TERRACOTTA INTO THE SHADOW SIDE, SO BOTH SIDES SIT IN ONE WARM FAMILY'. PANEL HOW THIS SKIN TAKES THIS LIGHT: annotated studies lettered 'TIGHT SMALL SPECULARS'; 'HARD-EDGED SHADOW TERMINATOR ACROSS CHEEK AND NECK'; 'LIT SIDE WARMED BY WALL BOUNCE'; 'SHADOW SIDE WARMED BY THE SAME BOUNCE — NO WARM-COOL SPLIT'; 'THE LIGHT CUTS, IT DOES NOT WRAP'. Hard single-source setup from camera-left so the terminator panel reads truthfully. Palette row with hex printed: #C89275, #B5543A, #F2EDE4. High label legibility, fine skin detail, no named individual, no brand text.
